name: Charlotte's Red
source:
Red is a violent criminal looking for freedom. Lottie is the nurse entrusted with her rehabilitation. A wolf and a pig in a house together for at least a year. What could go wrong?

[From [url=https://adotd.itch.io/charlottes-red]itch.io[/url]]
